name: CIViC-Fact v3 post-cutoff temporal-evaluation cohort, 2026-03-03 to 2026-06-09
description: CIViC entries submitted or revised in the stated window, used to probe curation drift after the CIViC-Fact dataset's last build. Pan-cancer; not EGFR- or NSCLC-tagged. Partial coverage only: most of the original 150 candidates are excluded before scoring, by design, for full-text access, source overlap, data-quality, and evidence-sufficiency reasons.

population.note: 150 - 68 - 14 - 2 = 66; 66 - 24 (NEI, supplement/image required) = 42 main-text-eligible; 42 - 2 (NEI, substantially revised claim) = 40 scored (9 + 7 + 24 = 40). Enriched cohort per source Discussion; not representative of CIViC overall. No EGFR or NSCLC subgroup is tagged anywhere in this cohort.

attributes.source_locator: Methods, 'Temporal evaluation' subsection (selection chain); Supplementary Figure 2 (printed page 33 / PDF page 34, 'Selection of CIViC entries for the post-cutoff cohort'); retrieval result reported in Results, 'Passage Retrieval Models Perform Well without Fine-Tuning' subsection (printed page 14 / PDF page 15).

review.note: Source-backed literature curation with independent automated transcription and scope checks, independently reviewed by Codex across two review cycles before ingestion. No new model execution, independent experimental replication, qualified human scientific review or clinical validation.

name: CIViC-Fact v3 within-linked-publication passage retrieval, post-cutoff cohort
description: For each post-cutoff CIViC entry with main-text-eligible evidence, the source publication is already known (CIViC's existing link from claim to paper). A passage-retrieval model ranks candidate passages from that single known paper and returns the top 5 as candidate evidence for the claim. The retrieved top-5 passages are then manually reviewed, per entry, for whether they contain appropriate (sufficient) evidence for the claim. The source separately reports that a curator, with group-consensus discussion for ambiguous cases, assigned the cohort's reference labels (Methods, 'Temporal evaluation'); that process description does not by itself specify the reviewer count, blinding, or replicate structure for the retrieval-success judgment reported in Results, and none of those is assumed here — recorded as unreported. This is retrieval of passages within one already-identified publication, not a literature-search or citation-context benchmark that finds which paper, among an open corpus, is relevant to a claim or question. It is not a stance/claim-verification (SUPPORTS/REVISIONS/NEI) benchmark on its own, and not the static, separately-scoped retrieval-subset evaluation (n_test=1120) reported elsewhere in the same source.

attributes.protocol: Fixed known-source-paper passage retrieval: claim input plus the single publication CIViC already links to it; retriever ranks passages and returns the top 5; entries requiring supplementary material or images are excluded (NEI) before scoring; the retrieved top-5 passages are then manually reviewed per remaining entry for 'appropriate' (sufficient) evidence. No automated/recomputed metric and no source-search or citation-context benchmark.

review.note: Source-backed literature curation with independent automated transcription and scope checks, independently reviewed by Codex across two review cycles before ingestion. No new model execution, independent experimental replication, qualified human scientific review or clinical validation.

limitations: Pan-cancer protocol; no EGFR- or NSCLC-specific subgroup or score.
Single post-cutoff temporal cohort (2026-03-03 to 2026-06-09); not an independent replication and not a second independent cohort.
Partial coverage: only 40 of the original 150 candidate entries are scored, after sequential exclusions for full-text access, source overlap, data error, and evidence sufficiency.
Enriched cohort per the source's own Discussion; not representative of CIViC overall.
Manual review judgment of 'appropriate' retrieved content; not an automated or recomputed metric, and no confidence interval is reported or recomputed here.

Reviewer count, blinding, and replicate/seed structure for this manual retrieval-success judgment are UNREPORTED in the source; the separately reported curator/group-consensus process for assigning the cohort's reference labels (Methods) does not specify these for the retrieval judgment, and none is assumed.
Status is source_checked (author-reported, transcribed); not reproduced by any Rewire execution.
Does not measure or substitute for the benchmark-execution gap tracked separately at rewire-benchmarks #28.
